target.work: E. Fermi, J. Pasta, S. Ulam (with M. Tsingou), Studies of Nonlinear Problems, I

expected_output.observable: energy of modes 1 through 5 versus cycle
expected_output.cycle_axis: computational cycles; one cycle is one integration time step

units.mass: unit mass at every interior site
units.time: dimensionless model time; reported abscissa is cycle count

mode_analysis.nonlinear_energy_note: The plotted modal energy omits the nonlinear potential contribution, as in the report; the omission is expected to be at most a few percent.

integrator.name: explicit central-difference (Stormer-Verlet)
integrator.implementation_assumption: The report's statement that derivatives were replaced by difference expressions is reconstructed as a position-space Störmer–Verlet / velocity-Verlet update; no author code is available.
startup_step: Compute a(x^0) from the stated initial displacement and fixed boundaries.
Drift: x^1=x^0 + dt*v^(1/2), then recompute a(x^1).
Complete the first step with v^1=v^(1/2)+(dt/2)*a(x^1).
subsequent_step: Recompute acceleration and complete the kick v^(n+1)=v^(n+1/2)+(dt/2)*a(x^(n+1)).
integrator.equivalent_position_form: x^(n+1)=2*x^n-x^(n-1)+dt^2*a(x^n) after the explicit first step
integrator.boundary_update: x_0 and x_N remain zero at every force evaluation

numerics.seeds: none; deterministic initial state and arithmetic

solver_settings.force_evaluations: one at each position update plus the startup evaluation
solver_settings.tolerance: not an iterative solver; no residual tolerance
solver_settings.overflow_policy: non-finite state is a failed run

compute_envelope.measurement: A throwaway float64 throughput probe on 2026-09-12 took 0.34 s for 30,000 iterations of the 32-site force/update shape; the later runner must measure and record its own runtime.
compute_envelope.memory_expectation: less than 256 MiB; streamed samples plus bounded state
compute_envelope.reproducibility: record host, Python version, package lock hash, git revision, input hashes, wall-clock start/end, and exit status

input_selection.input_sha256_recording: The runner records the CSV SHA-256 in run.json.
input_selection.preprocessing: Read the header and the named feature rows; use the digitized values only as references and do not infer or tune model parameters from the plotted curves.
input_selection.source_payload_policy: The LA-1940 PDF is fetched from the public URL into a temporary path; no PDF payload is tracked.

M1.name: first mode-1 recurrence time
M1.definition: argmax of E_1 over cycles 20000 through 30000
M1.reference: mode-1 first recurrence maximum t_cycles in fig1-digitized.csv

M3.name: first maxima of modes 2, 3, and 4
M3.definition: time and height of the first local maximum of each listed mode
M3.reference: mode-2/3/4 first maximum rows in fig1-digitized.csv

tolerance.time: within 5 percent of the digitized time
tolerance.height: within 10 percent of E_1(0), using the report-axis normalization

M4.name: higher-mode ceiling
M4.definition: max over cycles of sum of the plotted modal energies for modes 6 through 31

C1.name: linear-chain control
C1.definition: Set alpha=0 and verify E_1 remains within 1 percent of its initial value over 10000 cycles.

C2.name: full-energy conservation
C2.definition: Include the quadratic and cubic spring potential terms and measure maximum relative total-energy drift over the 30000-cycle baseline.

C3.name: time-step convergence
C3.definition: Repeat with dt/2 while holding physical elapsed time fixed, and compare the recurrence time after converting both runs to physical time.

decision_rules.failed_control: Any failed control makes the execution status 'failed control'; retain metrics and diagnostics.
decision_rules.discrepancy: M1 outside its tolerance is a 'discrepancy'; retain it and do not tune the baseline to the figure.
decision_rules.inconclusive: Use 'inconclusive' when required metrics or controls cannot be evaluated, when the reference feature is ambiguous beyond its stated uncertainty, or when the result does not decide the kill condition.
decision_rules.amendment: A changed method requires a new protocol/v2.json and protocol/v2.md with a dated reason. protocol/v1.json and protocol/v1.md are frozen and must never be edited after this task lands.
